title: Department Top 3 Salaries
prompt: Find employees whose salary is among the top 3 distinct salaries in their department. Return department_name, employee_name, and salary.
expected_query: WITH ranked AS (SELECT d.department_name, e.employee_name, e.salary, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.department_name ORDER BY e.salary DESC) AS salary_rank FROM employees e INNER JOIN departments d ON e.department_id = d.department_id) SELECT department_name, employee_name, salary FROM ranked WHERE salary_rank <= 3;
explanation: DENSE_RANK ranks distinct salary levels inside each department, preserving ties. Filtering rank <= 3 gives the top three salary levels.
hints: Use a CTE for ranked employees.
Use DENSE_RANK so ties share a rank.
common_mistakes: Using ROW_NUMBER and dropping tied salaries.
Ranking across the whole company instead of per department.
Filtering before calculating the window rank.
